content: सावित्र {%a.%} (-त्री|{%f.%}) [सविता देवताऽस्य अण्] .²1 Belonging to the sun; <ls>Mb. 7. 157. 34</ls>. .²2 Descended from the sun, belonging to the solar dynasty (of kings); यत् सावित्रैर्दीपितं भूमिपालैः <ls>U. 1. 42</ls>. .²3 Accompanied by the {%Gāyatree%}. .{@-त्रः@} .²1 The sun. .²2 An embryo or foetus. .²3 A Brāhmaṇa. .²4 An epithet of Śiva. .²5 Of Karṇa; भ्राता भ्रातरमज्ञातं सावित्रः पाकशासनिम् (अब्रवीत्) <ls>Mb. 1. 136. 8</ls>, <ls n="Mb.">13. 138. 9</ls>. .{@-त्रम्@} .²1 The sacrificial thread (so called because the repetition of the {%Gāyatree%} forms a principal part of the ceremony of putting on the sacred thread); शान्तिहोमांश्च कुर्वीत सावित्राणि च धारयेत् <ls>Mb. 13. 104. 60</ls>. .²2 The initiation into membership of the द्विज classes (by performing the thread ceremony); <ls>Bhāg. 3. 12. 42</ls>. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of the constellation Hasta; पञ्चतारेण संयुक्तः सावित्रेणैव चन्द्रमाः <ls>Mb. 1. 135. 30</ls>.
